select count(*) as cnt, a.MainDeptID, a.MainOrgID from cr_contractbasic a, (select ContractID, max(CreatedDate) as mcd from cr_contracttext group by ContractID) b, cr_contracttext c where a.ContractID = b.ContractID and b.ContractID = c.ContractID and c.CreatedDate = b.mcd and c.TextType = 1 and a.LogicDel = 0 and a.CheckDate is not null
and a.RuleSerialNum like concat('%', #{ruleSerialNum}, '%')
and a.ContractNum like concat('%', #{contractNum}, '%')
and a.ContractName like concat('%', #{contractName}, '%')
and a.MainDeptID = #{mainDeptID}
group by a.MainDeptID

select count(*) as cnt, a.MainDeptID, a.MainOrgID from cr_contractbasic a where a.LogicDel = 0 and a.CheckDate is not null
and a.RuleSerialNum like concat('%', #{ruleSerialNum}, '%')
and a.ContractNum like concat('%', #{contractNum}, '%')
and a.ContractName like concat('%', #{contractName}, '%')
and a.MainDeptID = #{mainDeptID}
group by a.MainDeptID
